items.title: Ernest McLean Interview, 1959-05-27
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...And this is Brown. Sidney Brown. Not Cindy Brown. ... [INTERVIEWEE] What was his name? Is that the Brown that plays tuba now?

ctx.x: Oh yeah, the drummer in back.
And Howard, Old Man Howard. Joe Howard. Joe Howard. And this is Brown. Sidney Brown. Not Cindy Brown. Jim Little they call him. No, not that Brown. Oh, there's another Brown. That plays tuba?
What was his name? Is that the Brown that plays tuba now?
